title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Independent Police Complaints and Misconduct Authority Bill
objective: Track police misconduct complaints, FIR registrations against officers, and inquiry outcomes.

indicators.name: Police Misconduct FIR Registration Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of verified police misconduct complaints resulting in direct FIR registration and investigation.

oversight.composition: Retired High Court judges, human rights advocates, legal experts

triggers.condition: Filing of a complaint alleging custodial death, firing injury, or sexual violence by a police officer.
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory temporary suspension order against accused officer
triggers.correction: Independent forensic investigation and binding charge sheet direction
